title: tdh.synth.1oscil.ui~
description: `tdh.synth.1oscil.ui~` is a GUI-controlled single-oscillator synth voice, intended as a building block for a larger synthesizer. Its waveshape, octave range, frequency or pitch, volume, modulation depths, and glide can be controlled from the GUI or through external messages and inlets; frequency and amplitude modulation signals provide vibrato and tremolo.
